03

Leave room for gas

Preview the native transfer budget with your own gas assumptions.

Simulated balance. Check an address for live data.

Example assumption; actual gas can differ.

Example ceiling; editable.

Maximum gas budget0.00084 USDC
Amount + gas budget10.00084 USDC

Short by 0.00084 USDC

This is a budget ceiling for the values above, not a gas estimate, transaction guarantee, or transfer. Gas also uses native USDC.

Why the two numbers?

Arc exposes USDC as an 18-decimal native asset and through a 6-decimal ERC-20 interface. Both represent the same balance. The ERC-20 display cannot show fractions smaller than one micro-USDC; this tool checks that any difference stays below that threshold.
